name: backend_url
label: Backend URL
help_text: Base URL of the Harvest Weigh backend, no trailing slash. e.g. https://harvest-weigh.yourdomain.com

name: api_key
label: API key (optional)
help_text: Must match the backend API_KEY. Leave blank if the backend has none set.

name: logo
label: Brand logo
help_text: Optional. Upload the farm's logo; falls back to a brand wordmark if empty.
